description: This file implements the basic library functions for Lua, including core functions like print, tonumber, error, getmetatable, setmetatable, and coroutine management functions. It defines and registers these functions for use within Lua scripts.

methods.name: luaB_print
methods.description: Implements the print function for Lua, printing all arguments to stdout separated by tabs.

methods.name: luaB_tonumber
methods.description: Converts a string to a number with optional base, supporting different numeral systems.

methods.name: luaB_error
methods.description: Raises an error with optional level and message.

methods.name: luaB_getmetatable
methods.description: Retrieves the metatable of a given Lua object.

methods.name: luaB_setmetatable
methods.description: Sets the metatable for a Lua table.

methods.name: luaB_getfenv
methods.description: Gets the environment table of a function or thread.

methods.name: luaB_setfenv
methods.description: Sets the environment table of a function or thread.

methods.name: luaB_rawequal
methods.description: Checks if two objects are equal without invoking metamethods.

methods.name: luaB_rawget
methods.description: Performs a raw get operation on a table.

methods.name: luaB_rawset
methods.description: Performs a raw set operation on a table.

methods.name: luaB_gcinfo
methods.description: Returns the current garbage collector count.

methods.name: luaB_collectgarbage
methods.description: Performs garbage collection operations based on options.

methods.name: luaB_type
methods.description: Returns the type name of a Lua object.

methods.name: luaB_next
methods.description: Iterates over a table.

methods.name: luaB_pairs
methods.description: Returns an iterator for pairs over a table.

methods.name: ipairsaux
methods.description: Auxiliary function for ipairs iteration.

methods.name: luaB_ipairs
methods.description: Returns an iterator for ipairs over a table.

methods.name: load_aux
methods.description: Helper function to handle loading status for scripts.

methods.name: luaB_loadstring
methods.description: Loads a string as a Lua chunk.

methods.name: luaB_loadfile
methods.description: Loads a Lua script file.

methods.name: generic_reader
methods.description: Reader function for loading scripts, calls a Lua function to get chunks.

methods.name: luaB_load
methods.description: Loads a Lua chunk from a function.

methods.name: luaB_dofile
methods.description: Executes a Lua script file.

methods.name: luaB_assert
methods.description: Checks a condition and raises an error if false.

methods.name: luaB_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks elements from a table.

methods.name: luaB_select
methods.description: Returns a subset of arguments based on index or '#'.

methods.name: luaB_pcall
methods.description: Protected call to a function, returns success status.

methods.name: luaB_xpcall
methods.description: Protected call with error handler.

methods.name: luaB_tostring
methods.description: Converts a value to a string, using __tostring metamethod if available.

methods.name: luaB_newproxy
methods.description: Creates a new proxy userdata with optional metatable.

methods.name: costatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a coroutine.

methods.name: luaB_costatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a coroutine as a string.

methods.name: auxresume
methods.description: Resumes a coroutine with arguments.

methods.name: luaB_coresume
methods.description: Wrapper to resume a coroutine, returning success and results.

methods.name: luaB_auxwrap
methods.description: Wraps a coroutine call for use as a function.

methods.name: luaB_cocreate
methods.description: Creates a new coroutine from a Lua function.

methods.name: luaB_cowrap
methods.description: Creates a wrapped coroutine function.

methods.name: luaB_yield
methods.description: Yields execution of a coroutine.

methods.name: luaB_corunning
methods.description: Returns the currently running coroutine.

methods.name: base_open
methods.description: Initializes the base library functions and coroutine support.
